author: Yffe
content:
RESOLVED in commit 2f5535a (single cause, two files).

ROOT CAUSE: mutation::early_return_value had Type::Vec (#74) + Type::Ref-slice (#48) arms but NO Type::String arm. join's body { a.concat(b) } has no binop/off-by-one/branch site -> 0 mutants -> 0/0 -> #48 anti-Goodhart backstop gated the genuinely-L3-proved join to WeakContract/L0. Verus proof itself SUCCEEDS (golden string_demo.verus.rs = 11 verified, 0 errors).

FIX:
- mutation.rs: Type::String arm + empty_string_value synthesizing TString { data: Vec::new() } (the exact lower.rs wrapper-newtype literal, mirroring the #74 empty-Vec arm). Every String-returning body now scored.
- cache.rs: CHECK_SCHEMA_VERSION 3 -> 4 — the gate verdict changed for String returns, so schema-3 certs (the stale L0) MUST invalidate (proof-cache REQ-2: a HIT == a fresh verify). Without this, forge check re-served the stale L0 on an identical lowered-source key.

VERIFICATION (real verus 0.2026.05.24):
- forge check conformance/string_demo.th: join -> L3 fx alloc (mutants 1/1, empty-TString synthesized + killed by ens result.len()==a.len()+b.len()); greeting_len/first_byte/literal_len unchanged L3.
- weak String contract (ens result.len() <= N): still L0 WeakContract 0/1 (empty TString SURVIVES — synthesis enables scoring, does NOT auto-pass; R-DEFER-9 honored, no proof cheat).
- pinned test divergence_join_l3_not_mutation_gated_l0 un-ignored, PASSES.

GAUNTLET:
- cargo test --workspace: 509 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored
- cargo test -p forge --test divergence_strings: 3 passed, 0 failed
- cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings: PASS
- cargo fmt --all --check: PASS

No regression: #74 Vec + #48 slice synthesis intact; conformance/ untouched (R-CHAR-3).
